forecast_journals.note: The issue body still says journal:append. That string is an alias and is refused. Canonical write grant would be journals:post — but the catalog has no forecast template, and posting project_cost* as a forecast would mix a what-if into the journal of record. This app is read-only relative to the journal: it emits CSV/JSON. Empty journals:post allowlist would refuse every post. Do not invent a write scope.

eac_compute.formula: remaining_to_spend = revised − incurred − awarded; EAC = incurred + remaining_to_spend + awarded (= revised) when that cut is supported; ETC = remaining_to_spend + awarded
eac_compute.note: Unset remaining-to-spend stays unset — never a silent forecast of 0. Treating awarded as 0 would print budget − actual as headroom. A posted 0.00 is a real zero. /budget still does not forecast. No CPI / percent-complete EAC (that is a rounded figure).
